originalIndependentReasons.scope: The image gives a PEM reaction scheme and the reversible Nernst basis. The current DE/EN descriptions and both whole cases explicitly separate this ideal voltage from loaded operation.
originalIndependentReasons.chemicalDrawing: H2 inlet at anode, O2 inlet at cathode, H2O outlet at cathode are correct. H+ arrows pass left→right through the membrane. Electron path runs left electrode→external lamp→right electrode; no electron path crosses the membrane. Reaction2H2+O2→2H2O uses4electrons; Q has water exponent2, hydrogen exponent2, oxygen exponent1, normalized pressures and negative RT/(4F)lnQ. Liquid water activity approximation is stated.
originalIndependentReasons.abstractLimits: A lamp correctly illustrates electrical energy use and does not by itself equate ideal Nernst E with its loaded terminal voltage. The page description and case12b state the distinction. Pressure ratios assume an ideal-gas model; changing T also requires the corresponding E°(T). The unchanged JPG is sound within those explicit boundaries.
originalIndependentReasons.sourceAndEvaluationOpenness: The formula supports calculation, not a technology ranking or ecological winner. It does not claim every fuel-cell chemistry uses protons; the drawing is the PEM example, and the prerequisite retains acidic/alkaline distinctions.
originalIndependentReasons.mobileActual360: PEM paths, H2/O2/H2O labels, equation sign and n=4 remain recognizable. Nested pressure-ratio subscripts are small; exact numerical work uses the readable larger view/current text cases, not pixel reading of this orientation thumbnail.
originalIndependentReasons.desktopActual680: Equation, indices, normalized pressure ratios and liquid-water note are readable; all paths remain separate and complete.
originalIndependentReasons.ageRepresentationAndPerspective: Clear conventional schematic with contrasting domains is appropriate for LK quantitative electrochemistry. No person or instrument scale introduces a conflicting user perspective.
originalIndependentReasons.formatAndArtifacts: Existing2752×1536JPG is close to16:9 and works at360×201/680×380. KEEP irrespective of original provider/JPG format. No watermark, technical ID, third-party logo, copied worksheet or protected character visible.
originalIndependentReasons.actualNativePage: Whole physical PDF page14 shows the reversible T/activity description directly under the unchanged image and the correct fuel-cell prerequisite. Current page model still embeds the old misleading altText, which the visible PDF does not display.
originalIndependentReasons.metadata: Whole current altText repeats the abandoned broad operating-conditions claim. This can describe loaded cell voltage as calculable by Nernst alone for nonvisual users. Historical prompt also repeats that original scope; preserve it as historical generation evidence and add an explicitly current context note if maintained. Link description/title/provider/url/lang remain consistent.
